blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat.
Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task.
Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others.
In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency.
To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states.
We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.
blocks.zh:
现代LLMS越来越有能力作为自主的代理,但它们遵循顺序交互周期:读,思考,回复或调用工具,重复.
许多现实世界使用的案例不是按顺序排列的:语音助理,包含的代理,监测系统在思考或执行其他任务时会收到新的投入.
现代LLMS以语音交互和视频流的专业架构,机器人控制的VLA,调用API的同步工具等来解决这个问题.
在这项工作中,我们将从不同的同步任务概括为能够适应不同类型货币的普通同步剂.
为了实现这一目标,我们开发了一个同步的LLM框架,让用户(或代理商本身)用重叠的内存状态定义推论皮层.
我们展示出 Quen 3.x 模型能够同步操作 流视频理解, 视频游戏, 以及监控, 没有任务特定的训练。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly capable autonomous agents, enabled by recent advances in reinforcement learning, tool use, and inference-time compute ( Kimi Team et al., 2025a ; Suzgun et al., 2023 ; Beeching et al., 2024 ) .
Modern LLMs can solve problems that require hours of uninterrupted reasoning, programming, and tool use ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) .
To solve these complex tasks, LLM agents follow a Thought-Action-Observation loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) : instead of solving the problem in one go, the agent reasons and defines an action such as running code, then observes the outcome (e.g., error traceback) to inform its next step.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越具有自主性,这是最近加强学习、工具使用和推论时间计算方面的进展所促成的(Kimi Team等人,2025a;Suzgun等人,2023;Beeching等人,2024)。
现代LLMS可以解决需要几个小时不间断的推理,编程和工具使用的问题(Jimenez等人,2024年;Schick等人,2023年;Gao等人,2023年).
为了解决这些复杂的任务,LLM代理遵循一个思考-Action-Observation循环(Yao et al., 2023 ) : 与其一去不复返地解决问题,代理解释和定义运行代码等动作,然后观察结果(如错误追踪),以告知其下一步.

blocks.en:
However, not all use cases allow for turn-based problem solving: a real-time voice assistant needs to listen while thinking and handling interruptions ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) , a self-driving car must quickly adjust to changes in traffic ( Zhou et al., 2024a ) , and even a fully virtual monitoring agent needs to react quickly when the operating system has issues ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) .
Human “agents” do this naturally, sometimes without thinking, because we evolved to process continuous information streams and react to new stimuli ( Eriksen & Schultz, 1979 ; Wessel & Aron, 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,并非所有使用案例都允许回合制解决问题:实时语音助理在思考和处理中断时需要倾听(Défossez等人,2024年),自驾车必须迅速适应流量的变化(周等人,2024a年),甚至完全虚拟监测代理也需要在操作系统出现问题时迅速作出反应(陈等人,2025年;唐等人,2026年).
人类“代理人”自然地这样做,有时没有思考,因为我们进化为处理连续的信息流并对新的刺激反应(Eriksen & Schultz,1979年;Wessel & Aron,2017年)。

blocks.en:
However, artificial LLM agents are not naturally asynchronous as they were built for sequences and trained on turn-based interaction.
The current state of the art treats each application with concurrency as a separate research problem.
Real-time voice and video assistants are explicitly built for concurrent thinking and listening ( Défossez et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024e ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Huang et al., 2026a ) and adjust when interrupted ( OpenAI, 2024a ; Cao et al., 2025 ) .
For embodied agents, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Driess et al., 2023 ) often follow a dual actor-thinker architecture ( Song et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) so they can react to stimuli while thinking.
The latest programming harnesses let the user “steer” the agent with extra inputs during reasoning ( OpenAI, 2026 ) ; others use asynchronous function calling or even multiple parallel sub-agents ( Ning et al., 2024 ; Ginart et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ) .
Currently, each of these research areas designs and trains agents for concurrency in their own task-specific manner.
blocks.zh:
然而,人工LLM剂并不是自然而然的同步剂,因为它们是为序列建造的,并经过回合式相互作用的培训.
目前的艺术状态将每种应用都作为单独的研究问题处理.
明确搭建实时语音和视频助理,用于同时思考和监听(Défossez等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年e;Lin等人,2025年b;Huang等人,2026年a),中断时进行调整(OpenAI,2024年a;Cao等人,2025年).
对于体现的代理人,Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型(Driess等人,2023年)经常遵循双演者-思想家架构(Song等人,2025年;Tan等人,2025年),因此可以在思考时对刺激做出反应.
最新编程利用了让用户在推理过程中有额外输入的代理“steer”(OpenAI, 2026) ;其他人使用同步函数调用甚至多个平行子代理(Ning等人, 2024;Ginart等人, 2024;Zheng等人, 2026a) .
目前,每个研究领域都以各自具体任务的方式设计和培训货币代理商。

blocks.en:
In this work, we study whether LLM agents can be made generally asynchronous , similarly to how they are general tool users and few-shot learners.
We hypothesize that, because modern LLMs learn to mimic human reasoning at some stage of their training, they may be able to imitate human asynchrony with proper framing.
To test this, we design a general framework for defining asynchronous LLM agents without task-specific fine-tuning.
Since communicating via text would be slow for many real-time applications, we leverage direct memory sharing ( Rodionov et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ) and extend its algorithms to support hybrid and multimodal language models.
We adopt the popular async/await programming model via asyncio ( van Rossum, 2012 ) to support concurrent LLM inference with asynchronous inputs and outputs, as depicted in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们研究LLM剂是否可以一般地成为同步的,类似于他们如何是一般的工具用户和少镜头的学习者.
我们假设,因为现代LLMs在训练的某个阶段 学会模仿人类的推理, 他们也许可以模仿人类 与适当的框架同步。
为了测试这一点,我们设计了一个总的框架,用于定义同步的LLM剂,而不进行特定任务的微调.
由于通过文本进行沟通对于许多实时应用来说会很慢,因此我们利用直接的内存共享(Rodionov等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2026a年),并扩展其算法以支持混合语言和多式联运模式.
我们通过Ayncio(van Rossum,2012年)采用受欢迎的Aync/await编程模型,以支持同步输入和输出的LLM推论,如图1所示。

blocks.en:
AsyncLLM lets the developer (or the agent itself) define multiple asynchronous coroutines that execute concurrently.
Each coroutine writes to its own “memory block” and can access other coroutines’ outputs using attention “views”.
This allows the developer to define coroutines that see each other’s progress in real time and handle new environment I/O without waiting for current reasoning to finish.
Our inference engine automatically groups concurrent inference requests for efficient batched GPU inference with shared memory, where every coroutine has its own view on the same cache blocks.
Our framework lets practitioners adapt existing state-of-the-art models to new concurrency scenarios or combine multiple scenarios that would otherwise require specialized data and expensive fine-tuning.
The three main contributions of this work can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
AsyncLLM 让开发者(或代理者本身)定义多个同时执行的同步皮层.
每个皮层都写到自己的"记忆区块",并且可以利用注意的"观点"获取其他皮层的输出.
这使得开发者可以在不等待当前推理完成的情况下,定义实时看到对方进步的皮层,并处理新的环境I/O.
我们的推论引擎会自动将高效批量的GPU推论请求与共享内存同时分组,其中每个Coroutine在同一个缓存块上都有自己的视图.
我们的框架使从业人员能够根据新的货币假设调整现有最新模型,或结合多种假设,否则将需要专门数据和昂贵的微调。
这项工作的三个主要贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en:
• We propose AsyncLLM, a general framework for training-free asynchronous LLM agents in the async/await programming model.
Our framework extends asynchronous programming primitives to define parallel LLM inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. • We describe an algorithm for parallel GPU inference with shared memory states (attention KVs, GDN recurrent states), allowing multiple instances of the same LLM to run concurrently while seeing each other’s progress in real time. Our algorithm supports hybrid and multimodal LLMs. 1 1 1 https://github.com/dvmazur/async_llm • We test the generality of AsyncLLM by constructing asynchronous agents for streaming video understanding, videogame environments, and system monitoring, based on the same family of Qwen3.x VLMs without task-specific fine-tuning.
Our experiments demonstrate that modern LLMs can use this programming model to define and modify their own coroutines in the same inference loop.
While this capability is not yet reliable, our results suggest that future LLM generations may create self-adapting agents from environment descriptions.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: Recent works have come up with asynchronous agents across vastly different research areas. In this section, we overview several of these areas and draw parallels in how they handle concurrency.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些著作 已经形成了一个同步的代理 跨越了非常不同的研究领域。 在本节中,我们概述了其中的几个领域,并在它们如何处理货币方面作了比较。

blocks.en:
Voice assistants ( Rubenstein et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023b ; OpenAI, 2024a ; Google, 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025 ) communicate with users in real time using either an
ASR-LLM-TTS  pipeline or, more recently, a multimodal foundation model ( Chu et al., 2023 ; Défossez et al., 2024 ; Xie & Wu, 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025a ) .
However, spoken conversation requires more than multimodality ( Roberts et al., 2015 ; Miksik et al., 2020 ; Mahmood et al., 2025 ) : natural speakers ask questions while thinking, interrupt each other, and read nonverbal cues as they talk.
This becomes even more pronounced in group conversation or talking while working together in a shared coding environment ( Flamino et al., 2025 ; Houde et al., 2025 ; Daryanto et al., 2026 ; Welter et al., 2025 ) .
To maintain natural conversations, modern voice assistants work in full-duplex mode, i.e., listen, think, and speak concurrently ( Défossez et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024e ; Veluri et al., 2024 ) with a slower background “thinker” ( Lin et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026b ) .
Advanced voice assistants have modules that detect interruptions (“barge-in”) to pause and adjust the response ( Selfridge et al., 2013 ; Zhao et al., 2015 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
语音助理 (Rubenstein等人, 2023年;Zhang等人, 2023年b;OpenAI, 2024年a;Google, 2024年;Anthropic, 2025年) 实时与用户交流,使用任意一种
ASR-LLM-TTS输油管或最近的多式联运基础模型(Chu等人,2023年;Défossez等人,2024年;Xie & Wu,2024年;Fang等人,2025年a)
然而,口语对话需要的不仅仅是多模式性(Roberts等人,2015年;Miksik等人,2020年;Mahmood等人,2025年):自然语者在思考时提问,互相打断,在交谈时阅读非语言提示.
这在群体对话或谈话中变得更加明显,同时在共同编码环境中共同工作(Flamino等人,2025年;Houde等人,2025年;Daryanto等人,2026年;Welter等人,2025年)。
为了保持自然对话,现代语音助理以全复式方式工作,即倾听、思考和同时发言(Défossez等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年e;Veluri等人,2024年),背景较慢的“思想家”(Lin等人,2025年b; 张等,2026;邹等,2026;吴等,2026b;黄等,2026b.
高级语音助理有检测中断的模块(“barge-in”),以暂停和调整响应(Selfridge等人,2013年;Zhao等人,2015年;Cao等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
In streaming video understanding ( Mun et al., 2019 ) , the model must keep up with real-time video to detect industrial incidents ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) , assist driving ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026b ) or comment on sporting events ( Mkhallati et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) .
As video signals are denser than audio, models typically cannot process every frame in real-time.
To combat this, recent works train lightweight “probes” that determine which frames can be skipped ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Kim et al., 2025a ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , and keep a small window of recent video frames and compress past events using text descriptions ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , hidden representations ( Qian et al., 2024 ) , or retrieval ( Ning et al., 2025 ) .
Streaming video models can watch and reason concurrently to reduce response delays ( Guan et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2025 ) .
The mechanisms used in these models are similar to the ones used in full-duplex voice assistants with interruption handling, but the probe is used not for voice interruptions but to detect changes in traffic situation ( Fang et al., 2003 ; Zheng et al., 2026b ) , handle GUI pop-ups, or react to user’s nonverbal cues ( Wahlster et al., 2001 ; Patapati et al., 2025 ) .
Full video assistants ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026a ) and GUI computer use agents ( Lin et al., 2025a ; Li & Shi, 2026 ) use similar techniques to process multiple input streams simultaneously.
blocks.zh:
在溪流视频理解(Mun等人,2019年)中,该模型必须跟随实时视频以发现工业事故(Gu等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年c;Yuan等人,2024年),协助驾驶(Huang等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2026年b)或评论体育赛事(Mkhallati等人,2023年;Yang等人,2026年a).
由于视频信号比音频更密集,模型一般不能实时处理每个帧.
为了打击这种现象,近期的作品培训了轻量级的“probes”,以确定哪些帧可以跳过(Wang等人,2025c;Kim等人,2025a;Ding等人,2025a;Yang等人,2026a),并保留一个小窗口,利用文字描述(Xu等人,2026年),隐藏表述(Qian等人,2024年),或检索(Ning等人,2025年)。
流媒体模型可以同时观看和说明原因,以减少反应延迟(Guan等人,2026年;Qian等人,2025年)。
这些模型中所使用的机制与全复式语音助理在中断处理中所使用的机制相似,但探测器不是用于中断语音,而是用于检测交通状况的变化(Fang等人,2003年;Zheng等人,2026年b),处理GUI弹出,或对用户的非语言提示作出反应(Wahlster等人,2001年;Patapati等人,2025年)。
完整视频助理 (Liu等人,2024b;Wang等人,2026a;Huang等人,2026a)和GUI计算机使用剂(Lin等人,2025a;Li & Shi,2026)使用类似的技术同时处理多个输入流.

blocks.en:
Embodied agents ( Ahn et al., 2022 ) use Vision-Language-Action models ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025b ; Sapkota et al., 2025 ) that process visual and text inputs and choose actions for a physical system they control. Most VLAs focus on a certain type of robotic system, such as mobile manipulators ( Black et al., 2025 ) or humanoid robots ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ) and require fine-tuning to adapt to a new type ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , while several more recent VLAs are trained to support several different embodiments ( Abeyruwan et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) .
Similar to voice and video assistants, embodied agents operate in an inherently asynchronous world and need to quickly adapt to interruptions and changes in the environment ( Zhou et al., 2024a ; Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ; Borate et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2025 ) .
Similar to full-duplex assistants, embodied agents think and act concurrently and use dedicated subroutines for processing unexpected interruptions ( Song et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh:
健康剂 (Ahn等人,2022年)使用Vision-Language-Action模型(Zitkovich等人,2023年;Kim等人,2025年b;Sapkota等人,2025年b)处理视觉和文字输入,并为他们所控制的物理系统选择动作. 大多数VLA侧重于某种类型的机器人系统,如移动操纵器(Black等人,2025年)或人造机器人(Bjorck等人,2025年),并需要进行微调以适应新型(Wang等人,2025年a; Sun et al., 2026),而最近几家VLA则接受培训,以支持几个不同的化身(Abeyruwan et al., 2025;Luo et al., 2026).
与语音和视频助理类似,内含的物剂在固有的同步世界中运行,需要迅速适应环境的中断和变化(周等人,2024a;冈萨雷斯-普马里加等人,2025;博拉特等人,2026;曹等人,2025).
与全复式助手类似,内含的代理人同时思考和行动,并使用专用的子例程处理意外中断(Song等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年b).

blocks.en: Virtual & Computer Use agents can control terminal shells ( Cao et al., 2024 ; Singer et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) , web browsers ( Hilton et al., 2021 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024a ; Zhou et al., 2024b ; Koh et al., 2024 ) , virtual environments ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Almeida, 2026 ) , desktop ( Wu et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) or mobile operating systems ( Zhang et al., 2023a ; You et al., 2024 ) . Their design varies between applications: a terminal agent has text-only inputs, a videogame agent requires vision and audio, and browser agents have both GUI ( Koh et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) and text-based inputs ( Hilton et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2024b ) . Similarly, the need for asynchrony varies from one application to another, but follows the same general patterns. A system monitoring agent ( Qi et al., 2023 ; Shetty et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) needs to process a continuous stream of logs from a running system to detect problems such as memory leaks or runaway processes, which is similar to streaming video understanding. Modern coding assistants allow users to alter an already running request via mid-turn steering ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and ask by-the-way questions ( Anthropic, 2026 ) . Though the exact steering mechanism is not disclosed, it follows the same pattern of concurrency as voice assistant interruptions.

blocks.en: Parallel reasoning and tool use. Parallel to application-specific asynchronous agents, several recent lines of research use concurrency in parallel LLM reasoning ( Sui et al., 2025 ; Ning et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) , asynchronous function calling ( Ginart et al., 2024 ; Gim et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) , and recursive sub-agents ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhang & Khattab, 2025 ) . In parallel reasoning, multiple LLM instances reason on the same problem together, solving subtasks or debating ideas ( Ning et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . Others apply a similar technique to overlap thinking with reading a long input ( Tong et al., 2025 ) , writing a response ( Yakushev et al., 2025 ) , or waiting for tool calls ( Ginart et al., 2024 ; Gim et al., 2024 ) . Recent works found that giving parallel sub-instances real-time access to each other’s thoughts allows them to coordinate faster ( Rodionov et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ) and ensure safety while reasoning ( Yakushev et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 平行推理与工具使用. 与应用特定的同步剂平行,最近几条研究线在并行的LLM推理中使用同位素(Sui等人,2025年;Ning等人,2024年;Wang等人,2022年),一个同步函数调用(Ginart等人,2024年;Gim等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年),以及递归亚剂. (Zhu等人,2024年;Zhang & Khattab,2025年). 在平行推理中,多个LLM实例在同一问题上共同解释,解决子任务或辩论想法(Ning等人,2024年;Jin等人,2025年). 其他人则采用类似技术,将思维与阅读长输入(Tong等人,2025年),撰写回复(Yakushev等人,2025年),或等待工具呼叫(Ginart等人,2024年;Gim等人,2024年)重叠。 近期的作品发现,给予平行的子事件实时接触对方的思想,可以让他们更快地协调(Rodionov等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2026年a),并在推理时确保安全(Yakushev等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b).

blocks.en: The applications we reviewed differ in modalities and deployment requirements, but they use similar patterns of concurrency. Parallel inference streams are used in both full-duplex visual assistant and for subtasks in parallel reasoning. Both streaming video understanding and system monitoring benefit from event probes. Both assistants and system monitors launch subroutines to handle interruptions. These agents use custom inference software that implements task-specific parallelism and communication and need to adapt the model for their setup. In this work, we propose a framework that generalizes between these applications without the need for task-specific training and inference.
blocks.zh: 我们审查的应用在方式和部署要求上各有不同,但它们使用类似的货币模式。 平行推论流既用于全复式视觉助手,也用于平行推理的子任务. 流媒体视频理解和系统监测都从事件探测器中受益。 助理和系统监视器都启动子例程来处理中断. 这些代理商使用自定义推论软件,这些推论软件执行针对特定任务的平行主义和通信,需要调整模型以进行设置. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个框架,在这些应用之间进行概括,而无需进行具体任务的培训和推论。

blocks.en: 3 Asynchronous Agents
blocks.zh: 3 同步代理

blocks.en:
We design AsyncLLM around the async/await programming model using Python asyncio standard library ( van Rossum, 2012 ) , where concurrency is defined through coroutines and synchronization primitives.
These coroutines run concurrent LLM inference while communicating through composable memory states (CacheBlocks) that contain attention KV caches and Gated Delta Network recurrent states ( Yang et al., 2025a ) for a slice of tokens.
Unlike prior works, AsyncLLM groups coroutines into batched GPU execution automatically, allowing users to focus on application logic.
blocks.zh:
我们使用 Python Asyncio 标准库(van Rossum, 2012) 来设计 AsyncLM 围绕 Async/await 编程模型, 其中通过皮层和同步原始来定义货币.
这些皮层同时进行LLM推论,同时通过包含注意KV缓存的可堆积内存状态(CacheBlocks)和Gated Delta Network的重复状态(Yang等人,2025a)进行通信,用于切片令牌.
与之前的作品不同,AsyncLLM将coroutines自动组合成批量的GPU执行,允许用户专注于应用逻辑.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Example AsyncLLM agent for implementing parallel reasoning and speaking (simplified).
blocks.zh: 图2:用于实施平行推理和说话的示例AsyncLM代理(简化).

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows how these components work together for an asynchronous agent that reasons about its task and simultaneously provides the user with the running summary of its progress, similar to interleaved or asynchronous reasoning ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Yakushev et al., 2025 ) .
The agent uses three cache blocks: one for the prompt, one for private reasoning, and one for the user-facing response.
This way, the “thinker” coroutine can write new thoughts into the reasoning block while the “writer” summarizes them in the response block.
The implementation consists of two coroutines: a “thinker” that produces the reasoning trace and a “writer” that summarizes it.
Since the writer needs to see the current reasoning progress, its cache view (L17) contains the thinker block before its own summary, reusing the memory state within.
In turn, the thinker does not need to see the writer’s output to reason about the problem, so its cache view only includes the problem and its own reasoning.
The thinker never explicitly communicates tokens to the writer. Instead it only notifies it about a finished paragraph, so the writer can summarize the progress by accessing the shared thinking block.

这样,“思考者”的胸围可以把新的想法写进推理块,而“写作者”则在反应块中总结这些想法。
执行工作包括两个圈子:产生推理痕迹的“思维者”和总结其内容的“写手”。

blocks.en: We organize the rest of this section as follows: Section 3.1 defines the AsyncLLM framework in more detail, Section 3.2 describes the algorithms for quickly reconstructing memory states from consecutive cache blocks by extending prior work on attention cache manipulation ( Rodionov et al., 2025 ) ; Section 3.3 covers efficient GPU inference with attention views.
blocks.zh: 我们将本节其余部分组织如下:第3.1节更详细地定义了AsyncLLM框架,第3.2节描述了通过扩展先前的注意力缓存操纵工作,从连续缓存区块中快速重建内存状态的算法(Rodionov等人,2025年);第3.3节涵盖了高效的GPU推论和关注观点.

blocks.en: 3.1 AsyncLLM Programming Model
blocks.zh: 3.1 合成LLM 方案拟订模式

blocks.en:
Every forward pass in AsyncLLM writes its memory state to a CacheBlock that contains
the model’s internal memory state for a continuous chunk of tokens. For modern hybrid transformers, this corresponds to KV caches for attention layers and state transitions for Gated Delta Nets (GDN).
Every forward pass writes to a single cache block, but can “see” multiple other cache blocks at once in arbitrary order.
We refer to these compositions as cache views, as depicted in Figures 1 & 2 .
Attending to multiple cache blocks is mathematically equivalent to attending to a single conventional KV cache containing the same tokens if those blocks were encoded sequentially. If multiple coroutines update their blocks concurrently while looking at each other, the resulting memory state is not equivalent to any sequential inference, but it remains legible to the LLM as we show below. This memory-based parallelism lets asynchronous agents run parallel sub-routines that synchronize instantly.
In contrast, if coroutines communicated with tokens, they would have to re-encode previously generated tokens every time the memory view changes, e.g. whenever the “thinker” in Figure 2 generates a new token.

AsyncLLM 中的每一个前传都将其内存状态写入包含缓存Block

每个前传都写给单个缓存块,但可以任意顺序一次“看到”多个其他缓存块。
我们将这些构成称为缓存视图,如图1和图2所示。

In the example above, api.forward (prefill) and api.generate use the same underlying forward pass algorithm that attends to a cache view and updates the provided cache block (write_to).

blocks.en:
Asynchronous LLM applications require the agent to react to signals: voice assistant interruptions, streaming video events, browser GUI pop-ups and, others.
In our framework this can be expressed by combining LLM inference with asyncio synchronization primitives: events, locks, queues, and so on.
For instance, consider a streaming video understanding agent that selects important frames with a “probe”, then notifies a background thinking coroutine about the event. In asyncio / async_llm, this can be expressed with an asyncio.Event that notifies the background thinker of an update. When multiple event-describing coroutines compile their descriptions into a shared report, they can use an asyncio.Lock to ensure the output is not garbled when merging.

在我们的框架中,这可以通过将LLM推论与Ayncio同步原始语结合起来来表达:事件,锁,队列等等.

blocks.en: 3.2 Inference with Multiple Cache Blocks
blocks.zh: 3.2 对多个缓存块的推论

blocks.en:
Next, we describe how AsyncLLM runs forward passes while attending to multiple cache blocks (cache_view). Recall that every cache block contains KV vectors and GDN recurrent states for a contiguous slice of tokens across all model layers. For traditional attention KV layers, we could combine KV caches by rotating every subsequent cache block’s keys to their new positions according to Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE, Su et al., 2024 ). However, that would require rearranging all past KVs for every forward pass, which would slow down inference. Rodionov et al. (2025) show that, for full attention with RoPE, one can compute attention without rotating previous KV blocks. Instead, they rotate only the current attention queries, keeping previous keys and values as-is.

It can be rewritten as follows: ⟨ ρ ⁡ ( q , i ) , ρ ⁡ ( k , j ) ⟩ = ⟨ ρ ⁡ ( q , i − j ) , ρ ⁡ ( k , 0 ) ⟩ , where ​ ρ ​ ( k , 0 ) = k \langle\rho(q,i),\rho(k,j)\rangle=\langle\rho(q,i-j),\rho(k,0)\rangle,\>\text{where}\>\rho(k,0)=k (1) The resulting algorithm keeps past KV caches on fixed 0-based positions (0, 1, 2, …) and computes attention by rotating the current queries relative to each block, producing equivalent attention outputs.

However, modern LLMs are not limited to traditional RoPE attention layers: most state-of-the-art open-weight models are hybrids where full attention layers are interleaved with either sliding window attention ( Gemma Team et al., 2026 ; Abadji et al., 2026 ) or, more frequently, linear attention or Delta Network variants ( Qwen Team, 2026b ; Kimi Team et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
Additionally, multimodal LLMs use multimodal rotary embeddings (MRoPE) ( Wang et al., 2024d ) for images, audio and video inputs. In AsyncLLM, we adopt the attention manipulation from Rodionov et al. (2025) for full attention layers and propose new algorithms for linear and multimodal attention.

blocks.en:
Concurrent multimodal attention. When processing image and video data, modern MLLMs use multimodal or multi-dimensional positional embeddings to encode a given image patch’s row and column indices along with its position in the video or image set.
MRoPE partitions key (or query) dimensions into temporal, height, and width sections and rotates each section based on a given token’s frame index (temporal), grid row (height) and grid column (width) indices.
If AsyncLLM attends to a cache block that contains image tokens, we rotate the current query to match the relative position in the temporal dimension and keep the two spatial axes unchanged. However, there is one more caveat that affects how cache blocks are stacked together. Since an image has multiple visual tokens for every temporal frame, a cache block with T T mixed visual and text tokens spans fewer than T T temporal positions, and it affects how the next block should be rotated. To account for this, we explicitly maintain per-block position spans instead of rotating by token count.
blocks.zh:
同时关注多式联运。 在处理图像和视频数据时,现代的MLLMs使用多模式或多维位置嵌入来编码给定图像补丁的行和列索引及其在视频或图像集中的位置.
MROPE将密钥(或查询)维度分为时空,高度,宽度等部分,并根据给定的令牌框架指数(时空),网格行(高)和网格列(宽)指数旋转每个部分.
如果 AsyncLLM 处理包含图像符号的缓存块,我们旋转当前查询,以匹配时间维度中的相对位置,并保持两个空间轴不变. 然而,还有一个警告会影响缓存块如何堆叠在一起。 由于一个图像对每个时间框架都有多个视觉符号,一个带有T T 混合视觉和文字符号的缓存块的跨度小于T T时间位置,它影响了下一个块应该如何旋转. 为此,我们明确保持每个街区的位置跨度,而不是按符号数旋转。

blocks.en: Combined with prior work on concurrent attention, this allows us run to inference on modern hybrid MLLMs with arbitrary cache views. Linear attention layers compose block-wise affine transitions, while full-attention layers use query rotation with MRoPE correction. The remaining MLP layers are invariant to cache views and can be computed normally. We discuss additional architecture variants in Appendix D . The remaining challenge is batching multiple coroutines on the same device.
blocks.zh: 这与先前关于同时注意的工作相结合,使我们能够用任意缓存视图推断现代混合 MLLM。 线性注意力层会组成块状的亲缘过渡,而全心层则使用带有MROPE修正的查询旋转. 其余的 MLP 层对于缓存视图无变化,可以正常计算. 我们讨论附录D中的其他建筑变体。 剩下的挑战是在同一个装置上分批多个皮层.

blocks.en: 3.3 Scheduling and Inference Engine
blocks.zh: 3.3 排程和推论引擎

blocks.en: We build the AsyncLLM inference engine over mini-SGLang 2 2 2 Based on https://github.com/sgl-project/mini-sglang , a minimal implementation of the SGLang framework ( Zheng et al., 2024b ) . Our reference implementation consists of three main components: i) the front-end that implements the asyncio-based AsyncLLM interface from Section 3.1 , ii) a balanced scheduling algorithm that lets reaction coroutines complete quickly without being clogged, and iii) efficient batched inference kernels with memory views based on Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们以https://github.com/sgl-project/mini-sglang为基础,在小型SGLang 2 2 2上建造AsyncLLM推论引擎,这是SGLang框架(郑等人,2024年b)的最低限度实施. 我们的参考实施由三个主要部分组成:(一) 前端从第3.1节执行基于Ayncio的AsyncLM接口,(二) 平衡的调度算法,使反应皮层快速完成而不堵塞;和(三) 高效的分批推论内核,基于第3.2节的内存视图。

blocks.en: Scheduling for asynchronous agents. AsyncLLM gathers incoming forward pass requests from all coroutines into a shared queue and forms batches for parallel execution. Both prefill and generation requests are mapped to the same batched LLM forward algorithm where requests of different lentghs and cache views can run in the same batch. To avoid situations where a quick response coroutine gets “clogged” by larger background requests, our engine forms balanced batches from all active coroutines. We employ chunked prefilling ( Agrawal et al., 2023 ) , i.e. mapping long prefills into multiple mathematically equivalent forward passes that can be batched with decoding for interactivity.
blocks.zh: 同步代理的时间安排 。 AsyncLLM 将来自所有皮层的前传请求收集到一个共享的队列中,并组成批次进行并行执行. 预填和生成请求均被映射到同一批量的LLM前方算法,不同lidgh和缓存视图的请求可以在同一批中运行. 为了避免出现快速反应皮层因较大背景请求而“堵塞”的情况,我们的引擎从所有活跃皮层中形成平衡批次。 我们采用块化预填(Agrawal等人,2023年),即将长预填图绘制成多个数学等效的前进通道,可以分批进行交互解码.

blocks.en:
Batched Inference. We take advantage of modern LLM frameworks using Paged Attention ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024b ) , i.e. splitting the KV cache into “pages”.
This lets us implement CacheBlocks as a light-weight data structure that holds references to attention pages and GDN affine transitions and implements update, merge, and clear operations.
When running a forward pass on a given batch, we use the existing mini-SGLang kernels for everything except inner Attention and GatedDeltaNet (after projections).
We track which cache views are needed for the active batch and feed them into the corresponding kernels: full attention with query rotation and MRoPE modifications, and GDN kernels that use the algorithm in Section 3.2 to construct the GDN state, then run Flash Linear Attention ( Yang & Zhang, 2024 ) . We discuss additional implementation details in Appendix C and evaluate inference latency and throughput under different synthetic workloads in Appendix E .

扣击推论. 我们利用现代LLM框架,使用Paged Note(Kwon等人,2023年;Zheng等人,2024年b),即将KV缓存分为“页”。
这让我们可以执行缓存时钟作为轻量级的数据结构,它可以保存对注意页和GDN afzine过渡的引用并执行更新,合并,并清除操作.
当运行一个给定批次的前进传球时,除了内在关注和GatedDeltaNet(在预测后)外,我们都会使用现有的微型SGLang内核进行所有工作.
我们跟踪当前批次需要哪些缓存视图,并将它们输入相应的内核:充分注意查询旋转和MROPE修改,使用第3.2节算法构建GDN状态的GDN内核,然后运行Flash Linear Recent(Yang & Zhang, 2024). 我们在附录C中讨论更多执行细节,并在附录E中评估不同合成工作量下的推断延迟性和吞吐量。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: The core idea of this work is that LLM agents can be made generally asynchronous without training, and that memory view manipulations from Section 3.2 let them react to asynchronous inputs. To better isolate each individual claim, we begin by evaluating individual text and image changes in Section 4.1 . Next, we evaluate AsyncLLM agents on real-time streaming video in Section 4.2 , interactive agents for videogames in Section 4.3 , and text-based system monitoring in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 本作的核心理念是LLM代理一般可以不经过训练而成为同步,来自第3.2节的内存视图操作可以让他们对同步输入作出反应. 为了更好地孤立每个个人索赔,我们首先评估第4.1节中的个别文字和图像变化。 接下来,我们评价AsyncLLM代理在4.2节的实时流媒体视频,4.3节的视频游戏互动代理,4.4节的文本系统监测。

blocks.en: 4.1 Sanity Checks: Single Asynchronous Input
blocks.zh: 4.1 卫生 检查 : 单同步 投入

blocks.en: We first test the simplest asynchronous setting: mid-reasoning user clarifications. The agent begins solving a math or image-QA task, then receives a missing detail or correction while thinking. We evaluate an AsyncLLM agent equivalent to AsyncReasoning ( Yakushev et al., 2025 ) , extended to hybrid LLMs using Section 3.2 , on hybrid-attention Qwen 3.5+ models ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试最简单的同步设置:中度解释性用户澄清. 代理开始解决数学或图像-QA任务,然后在思考时收到缺失的细节或更正. 我们评价一个相当于AsyncReasoning(Yakushev等人,2025年)的AsyncLM剂,该剂使用3.2节扩展至混合LLMs,关于混合注意的Quen 3.5+模型(Quen Team,2026b).

blocks.en: Asynchronous text inputs. We evaluate hybrid LLMs on MATH-500-Sharded ( Yakushev et al., 2025 ) , where each of 500 math problems ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) is split into an incomplete prompt and a clarification. The clarification is provided after k k reasoning steps. We report these evaluations in Figure 3 (left) and provide non-hybrid AsyncReasoning for reference.
blocks.zh: 同步文本输入 。 我们评价了MATH-500-Sharted上的混合LLMs(Yakushev等人,2025年),其中500个数学问题(Hendrycks等人,2021年)中每个问题被分为不完整的即时和澄清. 在kk推理步骤之后作出澄清。 我们在图3(左)中报告这些评价,并提供非hybrid AsyncReasoning供参考。

Asynchronous image changes. Next, we evaluate whether VLM-based agents can revise ongoing reasoning when visual evidence changes. We construct 513 image pairs from existing visual QA and math datasets.
For each problem, we edit the input image to add realistic “errors” and use
the original image as the “revised” version. The errors are constructed so that the problem cannot be solved correctly from the erroneous image. Dataset construction is described in Appendix F . The agent starts working with the erroneous (edited) image. After k k decoding steps, we replace it with the corrected image and add a notification that the input has changed.

同步图像改变 。 其次,我们评价基于VLM的代理人能否在视觉证据发生变化时修改正在进行的推理. 我们从现有的视觉QA和数学数据集中构建了513个图像对.
对于每个问题,我们编辑输入图像,添加现实的“错误”并使用
原图像为“修订版”。 错误的构造使得问题无法从错误的图像中正确解决. 数据集构建情况见附录F。 代理开始使用错误的(编辑)图像. kk解码步骤之后,我们用修正的图像替换,并添加一个输入已经改变的通知.

blocks.en: Figure 3 summarizes our results: AsyncLLM agents based on Qwen 3.x hybrid MLLMs can react to asynchronous inputs in both visual and text modalities. The visual agent shows trends similar to text interruptions, but the accuracy drops somewhat faster: upon closer inspection, we found that this is explained by the fact that visual tasks, on average, require less reasoning than MATH-500, and larger k k sometimes arrive when the agent has already produced the answer. Still, our results demonstrate that AsyncLLM agents can react to inputs while reasoning. In subsequent sections, we use this ability to process visual and text streams in more complex applications.
blocks.zh: 图3总结了我们的成果: 基于Quen 3.x 混合 MLLMs 的 AsyncLM 代理可以对视觉和文本模式中的同步输入反应. 视觉代理显示的趋势与文本中断相似,但准确度下降得有些快:在更仔细的检查后,我们发现,这是由视觉任务平均比MATH-500需要更少的推理来解释的,当代理已经生成答案时,较大的kk有时会到达. 然而,我们的结果表明,AsyncLLM剂可以在推理时对投入作出反应。 在之后的章节中,我们利用这种能力在更复杂的应用中处理视觉和文本流.

blocks.en: 4.2 Streaming Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 4.2 流媒体理解

blocks.en: We switch from a single image change to monitoring a continuous video stream and evaluate training-free Streaming Video Understanding. We evaluate on the SoccerNet-Caption ( Mkhallati et al., 2023 ) sports commentary dataset using the streaming evaluation protocol from Ding et al. (2025) , and on the ProactiveVideoQA mixed video benchmark using the official protocol ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们从一个单一的图像改变转向监测连续的视频流,并评价无培训的流视频理解. 我们利用丁等人(2025年)的流媒体评价协议,对SoccerNet-Caption(Mkhallati等人,2023年)的体育评论数据集,以及使用官方协议(Wang等人,2025年b)的主动VideoQA混合视频基准进行评估。 。 。 。

blocks.en:
The AsyncLLM agent consists of five concurrent components: 1) the event probe runs every frame and determines if it contains a new event worth describing.
If the probe triggers, the image pair (cache block) is passed to 2) the background thinking thread that reconstructs video events from frames.
At the same time, 3) the output probe checks if the reasoning contains a new event. If it does, the 4) description writer generates the event description from the thinker’s internal state, and a final non-LLM 5) output compiler coroutine gathers the results. Our agent uses training-free probes : instead of training a separate sub-module as in Ding et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2026a) , we run the base LLM as-is with a pre-filled prompt that determines important frames in a single forward pass. We provide a detailed agent description and prompts in Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
AsyncLLM 代理由五个并行组件组成: 1)事件探测器运行每个帧,并确定它是否包含一个值得描述的新事件.
如果探测器触发,图像对(cache块)被传递到2),从帧中重建视频事件的背景思维线程.
同时,3)输出探测器检查推理是否包含新事件. 如果是的话,4)描述作者从思想家的内部状态生成事件描述,最后的非LLM 5)输出编译器coroutine收集结果. 我们的特工使用无训练探测器:而不是像丁等人(2025年);杨等人(2026年a年)那样训练一个单独的子模块,而是用预先填充的提示器来运行LLM基础,在单一的前进通道中决定重要的帧. 我们在附录G中提供了详细的代理人描述和提示。

blocks.en:
We evaluate AsyncLLM with three Qwen 3.x models and compare it against Mage-VL ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , a recent model trained specifically for video streaming (see Appendix H for hyperparameter tuning). We follow the standard evaluation protocol for both benchmarks: event probe ROC AUC, TriggerAcc (fraction of correctly
predicted events), and TimVal (which balances speak and silence correctness). On ProactiveVideoQA, we also report Proactive AUC with the recommended response delay weight (PAUC ω = 0.5 \omega{=}0.5 ) and report other ω \omega in Appendix H . Table 1 summarizes our results: AsyncLLM with Qwen3.5+ models outperforms the more specialist Mage-VL on both benchmarks. While the official evaluation protocol for SoccerNet does not measure description quality, the larger Qwen3.5+ models also provide more accurate descriptions on ProactiveVideoQA. We see this not a weakness of Mage-VL that was trained with different priorities, but a positive side-effect of using generalist MLLMs in AsyncLLM. Finally, we report inference speed in Table 3 .

blocks.en: 4.3 Interactive Agents for Video Games
blocks.zh: 4.3 电子游戏互动代理

blocks.en:
Next, we move from passive monitoring to agents that affect their environment. We evaluate on two ViZDoom scenarios based on the videogame Doom ( Kempka et al., 2016 ; Wydmuch et al., 2018 ) : HealthGathering and DeadlyCorridor (frame skip 4).
We modify the AsyncLLM agent architecture from the previous section: instead of describing the video stream, the background thinker module determines the course of action (e.g. ‘‘turn right until you are aiming at the rightmost enemy’’) and a faster action subroutine converts it into frame-by-frame actions with an early-exit probe that determines when the action can be picked.
We compare against two baseline agents: sequential and probe-only.
Before interacting, the agents are prompted with the environment rules and action space and allowed to reason about strategy.
Then, on each frame, they observe two latest frames from the environment and are probed to choose action.
We prompt the sequential agent to write short single-paragraph reasoning to avoid overthinking.
We also evaluate a faster probe-only agent that runs one forward pass per frame with a pre-written template 3 3 3 “Based on …, the next action is: ___”, after which we take a valid action token with the highest probability. .
The results in Figure 4 show that the AsyncLLM agent can react much faster than a sequential agent based on the same model while preserving the gains from reasoning.
This demonstrates that AsyncLLM can generalize existing VLMs to interactive videogame agents without training. That said, our results only demonstrate the basic capability, not state-of-the-art performance for these specific environments.
We also experiment with letting agents define their own coroutines based on the environment and AsyncLLM API (see Appendix J ), which shows good initial results on HealthGathering but inferior on DeadlyCorridor.

blocks.en: 4.4 System Monitoring Agents
blocks.zh: 4.4 系统监测代理人

blocks.en:
For our next evaluation, we analyze the AsyncLLM agent for system monitoring ( Qi et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . In this setup, the agent works with an input stream of system logs from a running application and detects anomalies, such as memory leaks or runaway file descriptors. We use the Monitoring subset from the DevOps-Gym benchmark ( Tang et al., 2026 ) consisting of 34 tasks.
The original setup only measured accuracy with several types of anomalies such as network latency spikes or system handle leaks.
We modify our evaluation setup to account for how quickly the system responds: we let the agents perceive logs in real-time and measure, on average, how soon the agent answered and how many inference steps it used. To make our results GPU-agnostic, we report the number of forward passes. This is equal to the number of output tokens for the sequential baseline but counts two tokens generated in the same batch as one forward pass (see in Table 3 for throughput reference). The AsyncLLM agent has, on average, 2.06 active coroutines for this task.

最初的设置仅用网络延迟悬浮或系统手柄泄漏等几种异常类型测量精度.
我们修改我们的评估设置,以说明系统的反应有多快:我们让代理人员实时看到日志,并平均衡量代理人员的回答有多快,以及使用多少推断步骤。 为了使我们的结果是GPU不可知的,我们报告前程通行证的数目。 这等于相继基准的输出符数,但把在同一个批次中产生的两个符数与一个前传符数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数,数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数,数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数数 AsyncLLM剂平均有2.06个活化皮层来完成这项任务.

blocks.en:
The AsyncLLM monitoring agent follows the same architecture as in Streaming Video Understanding except for a different input format: instead of images, the agent receives chunks of logs split by lines up to 1 second or 1024 characters long (at least one line). We compare AsyncLLM against three alternatives that use the same paradigm: a baseline sequential agent with the same model that gives the answer after the whole sequence, a sequential agent with an early-answer tool after every log chunk (same prompt as AsyncLLM), and a faster baseline agent that checks whether it should reason on a given chunk of logs or skip it entirely.
We use an additional prompt paragraph that ensures the agent only worries about resource usage issues and limits its reasoning to keep up with the current events. Without that, we found that Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B was overthinking unrelated issues and fell behind real-time logs resulting in < 10 % {<}10\% accuracy. We apply the same anti-distraction prompt to AsyncLLM and baselines. Table 2 summarizes our results: for both models, the asynchronous monitoring agents can detect problems with comparable accuracy, but significantly faster than comparable sequential agents, using same concurrency principles as the streaming video agent in Section 4.2 .

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigated the ability of large language models to operate as asynchronous agents over a diverse set of environments.
Our results suggest that asynchrony can be treated as a general capability rather than a collection of domain-specific skills.
We found that modern MLLMs already have the capacity to handle concurrent sub-tasks and react to new stimuli without task-specific asynchronous training.
Similarly to early tool-use agents, they do not always outperform purpose-trained models on their specific domains, but are much easier to adapt to new applications.
To facilitate this adaptation, we formulated AsyncLLM, a framework that lets the user define asynchronous agents in the async/await programming model, and proposed efficient algorithms that extend this capability to modern hybrid and multimodal LLMs.
Our experiments demonstrate that AsyncLLM agents can generalize to asynchronous text and visual updates, streaming video understanding, system monitoring, and even interactive videogame agents.
This could enable real-time asynchronous APIs that let users run LLMs in asynchronous environments, e.g. by supplying the agent definition through the API. Alternatively, proprietary LLMs can write their own harness from the user’s prompt.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们调查了大型语言模型在多种环境中作为同步剂运行的能力.
我们的结果显示,同步可被视为一般能力,而不是特定领域技能的集合。
我们发现,现代的MLLM已经有能力处理同时执行的子任务,并对新的刺激作出反应,而不进行具体任务的同步训练。
与早期工具使用剂类似,它们并不总能超越特定领域的目的训练模型,而是更容易适应新的应用。
为了便利这种适应,我们制定了AsyncLLM,这个框架允许用户在Async/await编程模型中定义一个同步代理,并提出了将这种能力扩展到现代混合和多式联运LLM的高效算法。
我们的实验表明,AsyncLLM代理可以概括为同步文本和视觉更新,流传视频理解,系统监测,甚至交互式视频游戏代理.
这可以实现实时同步 允许用户在同步环境下运行LLMs的API,例如通过API提供代理定义. 或者,专有的LLMs可以从用户的提示中写出自己的控制器。

blocks.en: This opens two interesting directions for future research: i) training LLMs to be better general asynchronous agents, in the same sense that current LLMs train to be better general tool use agents, and ii) further investigating the agent’s ability to improve its own coroutines for the given scenario.
blocks.zh: 这为未来的研究开辟了两个有趣的方向:(一) 训练LLMs成为更好的一般同步剂,同样意义上说,目前的LLMs训练成为更好的通用工具使用剂,和(二) 进一步调查该剂在给定情景下改善自身皮层的能力。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work studies general-purpose asynchronous LLM agents that can observe, reason, and act concurrently. While this can improve responsiveness in applications such as streaming assistants, monitoring systems, and embodied or interactive agents, it also introduces additional risks. Concurrent execution may cause an agent to emit an incorrect or harmful action before slower reasoning or monitoring coroutines can intervene, and asynchronous inputs may change an agent’s behavior while other computations are still in progress.
More capable asynchronous agents may also increase the usefulness of LLMs for dual-use applications such as automated system interaction, surveillance, or other continuously operating agents. Additionally, we ran experiments with self-modifying agents that needed sandboxing and strict limits on the tools, files, and external systems that an agent is allowed to modify.
Real-world deployments of AsyncLLM agents in sensitive use cases should include appropriate guardrails, sandboxing, output/action validation, and monitoring, depending on the deployment scenario.
blocks.zh:
这项工作研究的是能够同时观察、解释和行动的同步LLM剂。 虽然这可以提高流程助理、监测系统和内含或互动代理等应用程序的响应能力,但也带来了额外风险。 同步执行可能导致代理人在推理或监控较慢的皮层前释放出不正确或有害的动作,同步输入可能会在其它计算仍在进行时改变代理的行为.
更有能力的同步剂也可能提高LLMS对自动系统交互、监视或其他连续操作剂等双重用途应用的效用。 此外,我们用自我修改剂进行了实验,这些剂需要沙箱,并且严格限制允许代理人修改的工具、文件和外部系统。

While conducting the experiments for this work, we noticed that most applications, despite their variety in function and modalities, share a set of recurring design patterns.
We distinguish five complementary patterns; a single system may combine several.
These design patterns could be further abstracted away from developers in higher-level frameworks.

blocks.en:
Asynchronous agents differ from traditional LLM workloads in that they need to respond to incoming signals, such as voice interruptions, monitoring alerts, and updates from their own coroutines.
To allow this level of interactivity, we develop a specialized GPU scheduling policy which services the active coroutines without letting any single request “clog” the pipeline.
In this section, we describe this scheduling policy and discuss how it is implemented on top of existing LLM inference frameworks.
blocks.zh:
同步剂不同于传统的LLM工作量,因为它们需要响应传入的信号,如语音中断,监控警报,以及来自自身皮层的更新.
为了能够进行这种程度的互动,我们制定了专门的GPU调度政策,为主动的皮层提供服务,而不让任何单一的请求“记录”管道。
在本节中,我们叙述这一时间安排政策,并讨论在现有LLM推论框架之外如何执行这一政策。

blocks.en:
AsyncLLM modifies the popular first-come-first-served ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024a ) scheduling strategy to
let all coroutines within the same inference session progress simultaneously.
To reduce the latency of processing mixed prefill-decode batches, we employ chunked prefilling ( Agrawal et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2024 ) : bounding the number of tokens from a single request that can be processed in a single engine tick.
The resulting scheduler is similar to fair queuing in networking and certain inference engines ( Nagle, 1987 ; Sheng et al., 2024 ) , but the purpose is different: instead of fair sharing between users, our scheduler ensures that a quick reactive coroutine can complete without being clogged by background processing.
This would normally cause inefficient memory access as each request has its own KV cache.
However, AsyncLLM coroutines reuse each other’s cache blocks, allowing for efficient batched inference using the derivations in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh:
AsyncLLM修改了流行的先来先得战略(Yu等人,2022年;Wu等人,2024年a)
让同一推断会话中的所有皮层同时取得进展。
为了减少处理混合预填解码批次的耐久性,我们采用块式预填(Agrawal等人,2023年;Agrawal等人,2024年):从单一引擎勾选处理的单项请求中限定代币数量.
由此产生的调度器类似于在网络和某些推论引擎中的公平排队(Nagle,1987年;Sheng等人,2024年),但目的不同:我们的调度器不是在用户之间公平分享,而是确保快速反应的皮质可以完成而不受到背景处理的堵塞.
这通常会导致内存访问效率低下,因为每个请求都有自己的KV缓存.
然而,AsyncLM皮层再利用对方的缓存区块,从而能够利用第3.2节中的衍生物进行有效的批量推论。

blocks.en:
Our scheduling treats prefill and decode requests equally and schedules them based on how many tokens they need to process.
When multiple coroutines place inference requests concurrently, the engine forms a balanced batch that lets each coroutine process a share of tokens even if some of them scheduled a large prefill requests.
For instance, if a decoding coroutine placed a single-token request when two other coroutines have already placed their expensive prefills (e.g. image or file), our scheduling policy will form a batch with the single-token request and take equal chunks ( ± 1 \pm 1 ) out of the prefill requests, up to the maximum batch size. If there are more tasks than the number of tokens the device can fit, they are put in alternating batches.
blocks.zh:
我们的日程安排对预填和解码请求一视同仁,并根据它们需要处理多少个令牌来安排它们.
当多个皮层同时放置推论请求时,引擎会形成一个平衡的批次,让每个皮层处理一个部分的代号,即使其中一部分会安排一个大型的预填请求.
例如,如果一个解码的coroutine在另外两个coroutine已经放置了昂贵的预填(例如图像或文件)时放置了单键请求,那么我们的排程策略将会与单键请求形成一个批次,并从预填请求中取出相等的块(±1\pm 1),最高可达最大批次大小. 如果任务比设备能够装配的符号多,则被放入交替批次中.

blocks.en:
AsyncLLM enqueues incoming requests from all coroutines into a single double-ended queue.
The scheduler loads requests from the queue up to the maximum simultaneous batch size to avoid memory overflows.
Once the engine is ready to process a new batch, it pulls requests from the front of the queue and forms the batch as described above.
After the batch is formed, any requests that still have remaining tokens (i.e. long prefills) are placed back into the queue so they can be finished later.
The engine then computes a batched forward pass layer by layer: FFN and MoE layers process tokens independently, while attention and GDN layers use the multi-cache inference from Section 3.2 to attend to each other’s memory in real-time.
One notable exception is multiple coroutines writing to the same cache block, which would cause undefined behavior if placed in the same batch. To avoid this, our scheduler services the first such coroutine and delays others to subsequent batches.
blocks.zh:
AsyncLLM 将来自所有皮层的请求排入单一的双限队列.
排程器从队列加载请求,最高可达最大同时批量大小,以避免内存溢出.
一旦发动机准备好处理新批次,它就会从队列前方拉出请求,形成上述批次.
批次形成后,任何仍有剩余符号(即长预填)的请求都会被放回队列中,以便日后完成.
引擎然后逐层计算一个批次的前进传承层:FFN和MOE层独立处理符,而注意力和GDN层则使用第3.2节的多卡切推论实时处理对方的内存.
一个值得注意的例外是写到同一缓存块的多块皮层,如果放置在同一批内,会造成未定义的行为. 为了避免这种情况,我们的排程器服务 第一次这样的皮合金 并推迟其他人到以后的批次。

blocks.en:
We build our reference implementation of the AsyncLLM inference engine over mini-SGLang 4 4 4 Based on https://github.com/sgl-project/mini-sglang .
Our implementation significantly modifies the scheduling strategy to support mixed prefill and decode batches, as well as implementing support for prefill chunking.
We also adjust the queuing mechanism to balance decode requests with prefill instead of processing them in FIFO order.
We implement GDN support to target the Qwen 3.5+ ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) model families and add vision support for it.
The cache blocks are implemented as a lightweight data structure that holds references to page table slots and GDN states.
We adjust the key-value caching mechanism to store keys with zero-based RoPE positions and modify the paged-attention kernel to apply relative query RoPE inside the attention kernel.
blocks.zh:
我们基于https://github.com/sgl-project/mini-sglang,将AsyncLLM推论引擎在小型SGLang 4 4 4 上建立参考实施。
我们的实施大大修改了列表策略,以支持混合预填和解码批次,以及实施预填块的支持.
我们还调整排队机制,以平衡解码请求与预填,而不是按照FIFO顺序处理.
我们实施GDN支持,以Quen 3.5+(Quen Team,2026b)模式家庭为目标,并为之增加愿景支持.
缓存块作为轻量级数据结构执行,它持有页面表格槽和GDN状态的引用.
我们调整密钥值缓存机制,以零基的 RoPE 位置存储密钥,并修改页面-注意内核,在关注内核内部应用相对查询 RoPE.

blocks.en:
We run all our experiments with open models and a local inference server.
While our reference implementation does not implement an HTTP API, we see two potential ways to run custom AsyncLLM agents over the network: either using a modified realtime API ( OpenAI, 2024b ; Google, 2026 ) where the user passes the AsyncLLM agent definition that is executed in a sandboxed environment, or by allowing the LLM itself to write the agent definition based on the prompt, which may be preferred by proprietary LLM providers.
blocks.zh:
我们用开放式模型和本地推论服务器 来运行我们所有的实验
虽然我们的参考执行不执行HTTP API,但我们看到有两种潜在的方式在网络上运行自定义的AsyncLLM代理:要么使用经过修改的实时API(OpenAI, 2024b; Google, 2026),即用户通过在沙盒环境中执行的AsyncLLM代理定义,要么允许LLLM本身根据即时写出代理定义,这可能会被专有的LLM供应商所偏爱.

blocks.en: We follow the standard best practices for LLM inference on NVIDIA GPUs inherited from the base framework, such as CUDA graphs and optimized Mixture-of-Experts kernels for sparse models. However, note that our reference implementation does not collect every possible code optimization and should be considered a minimal implementation of the AsyncLLM API, with room for further technical optimization. Despite this, we found that even this implementation can achieve real-time or near real-time performance through concurrency and memory reuse.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循从基础框架继承的关于NVIDIA GPU的LLM推论的标准最佳做法,如CUDA图和为稀疏模型优化了Mixture-of-Experts内核. 然而,请注意,我们的参考实施并不收集所有可能的代码优化,而应被视为AsyncLM API的最低限度实施,还有进一步技术优化的余地。 尽管如此,我们发现即使这种执行也能通过货币和内存再利用实现实时或接近实时的性能.

blocks.en: Appendix D Compatibility with different architectures
blocks.zh: 附录D 与不同架构的兼容性

blocks.en: Although we focus mainly on the Qwen 3.5+ architectures there is no fundamental limitations for our approach to generalize for other models and inference stacks. In this section we provide details for popular architectural variations.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们主要关注Quen 3.5+架构,但我们对其他模型和推论堆栈的概括方法没有根本的限制. 本节详细介绍受欢迎的建筑变化。

blocks.en: D.1 Efficient inference techniques
blocks.zh: D.1 有效的推论技术

blocks.en: AsyncLLM execution algorithms are compatible with weight quantization, KV compression, and speculative decoding, though we do not focus on that in the paper. Weight compression ( Frantar et al., 2022 ; Egiazarian et al., 2024 ; Egiazarian et al., 2026 ) can be integrated as-is since AsyncLLM only alters attention and GDN kernels after the affine projectors. KV cache quantization, eviction, or offloading ( Zhang et al., 2023c ; Liu et al., 2024c ; Hooper et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024 ) can be supported on a per-block level. Finally, speculative decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024b ) can be integrated into api.generate(…), which will convert it from single-token requests to multi-token validation phases after which only the accepted tokens stay in cache. We do not use speculative decoding or compression in our experiments to disentangle the efficiency gains from AsyncLLM and from these inference optimization techniques.
blocks.zh: AsyncLLM执行算法与量子化,KV压缩,以及投机解码是相容的,尽管我们在纸张中并不关注这一点. 重量压缩(Frantar等人,2022年;Egiazarian等人,2024年;Egiazarian等人,2026年)可以按原样进行整合,因为AsyncLLM只改变注意力和在affine投影仪之后的GDN内核. KV缓存量化、驱逐或卸载(Zhang等人,2023c;Liu等人,2024c;Hooper等人,2024;Lee等人,2024)可按每块水平支持。 最后,投机解码(Leviathan等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年b)可以被集成到api.generate(.)中,它将从单键请求转换为多键验证阶段,之后只有被接受的代币留在缓存中. 我们并不利用实验中的推测解码或压缩来分解AsyncLLM和这些推论优化技术的效率收益.

blocks.en: D.2 Full Attention variations
blocks.zh: D.2 充分注意的差异

blocks.en:
AsyncLLM is directly compatible with sliding-window and other position-defined local attention ( Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2023a ) mechanisms.
For a causal sliding window of size W W , a query at logical position i i attends only to cached tokens at positions j j satisfying 0 ≤ i − j < W 0\leq i-j<W .
When constructing a cache view, the active window can be determined using the logical positions of tokens in the composed view rather than their physical locations in the KV cache.
The corresponding keys and values remain unchanged, while the attention kernel applies both the local mask and the RoPE/MRoPE query corrections from Section 3.2 .
The same principle applies to chunked or block-local attention, provided chunk membership can be reconstructed from the logical positions of the composed cache view.
Thus, rearranging CacheBlocks may change which cached tokens are visible to a query, but does not require rewriting the cached representations themselves.
blocks.zh:
AsyncLLM直接兼容滑窗和其他定位定义的地方关注(Beltagy等人,2020年;Jiang等人,2023a)机制.
对于大小为 W W 的因果滑动窗口, 逻辑位置的查询 i 仅用于满足 0 ≤ i - j < W 0\leq i-j < W 位置的缓存符 。
在构建缓存视图时,活动窗口可以使用组成视图中的符符的逻辑位置而不是它们在KV缓存中的物理位置来确定.
相应的密钥和值保持不变,而关注内核既适用本地掩码,又适用来自第3.2节的ROPE/MROPE查询更正.
同一原则也适用于块状或块状局部注意,但块状成员可以从所组成的缓存视图的逻辑位置重建。
因此,重新安排缓存Blocks可能会改变哪些缓存的令牌可以被查询所看到,但不需要重新写入缓存的表达式本身.

blocks.en:
The cache-view construction does not assume a one-to-one correspondence between query and key–value heads.
Multi-Query Attention (MQA) ( Shazeer, 2019 ) and Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) therefore require no conceptual modification: several query heads may share the same cached key–value head, and the appropriate per-block positional correction is applied to each query head before attending to the shared cache.
AsyncLLM can also be extended to model-native compressed attention mechanisms such as Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025a ) .
In MLA, the model caches a compressed latent representation from which key and value information is recovered, together with a separate positional component in implementations using decoupled RoPE.
The position-independent latent state can be reused across cache views unchanged, while the positional component requires the same logical-position correction as conventional RoPE attention.
Supporting MLA primarily requires adapting the model-specific attention kernel and cache representation rather than changing the CacheBlock abstraction itself.
We leave an optimized MLA implementation to future work.
blocks.zh:
缓存视图构建不假设查询和密钥-值头之间的一对一对应.
因此,多查询注意(MQA)(Shazeer,2019年)和分组查询注意(GQA)(Ainslie等人,2023年)不需要在概念上进行修改:多个查询头可能共享相同的缓存密钥–值头,在访问共享缓存之前,每个查询头都应用适当的每块位置校正.
AsyncLLM也可以扩展至模型-内置压缩的注意机制,如多头Latent Region(MLA)(刘等人,2024a;刘等人,2025a).
在司法协助中,模型缓存了一种压缩的潜在表示,从中回收关键和价值信息,同时使用脱钩的ROPE在执行中另设一个位置部分。
位置独立的潜伏状态可以在缓存视图中不改变地重复使用,而位置组件则需要与常规的RoPE关注相同的逻辑位置校正.
支持MLA主要需要调整模型特定关注内核和缓存代表,而不是改变CacheBlock抽象化本身.
我们把最佳的司法协助执行工作留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
Our method is also potentially compatible with model-native sparse-attention mechanisms such as Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA) and DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) ( Qwen Team, 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025a ) .
These mechanisms use a lightweight learned indexer to select a subset of cached tokens or blocks for each query before evaluating attention over the selected entries.
Since AsyncLLM changes the logical composition and positions of cache blocks without modifying their stored key–value representations, the indexer can operate over the composed cache view and gather the selected entries directly from the underlying page tables.
Supporting this setting would primarily require making the indexer and sparse-attention kernels aware of the logical block order and relative positions, including the RoPE or MRoPE corrections described in Section 3.2 .
Sparse attention is therefore complementary to AsyncLLM: our framework provides concurrent execution and shared memory views, while QSA and DSA can reduce the cost of attending over long composed views.
We leave the implementation and empirical evaluation of this to future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法也有可能与模式-本土的稀疏关注机制相兼容,如Quen Sparse Region(QSA)和DeepSeek Sparse Regence(DSA)(Quen Team,2026a;Liu等人,2025a).
这些机制使用一个轻量级的学习索引器,在评价所选条目的注意力之前,为每个查询选择一个缓存的符号或块的子集.
由于 AsyncLLM 修改缓存块的逻辑组成和位置,而不修改其存储的密钥 - 值表达式,索引器可以运行在所组成的缓存视图上,直接从基础页面表格中收集所选条目.
支持这种设置,主要需要使索引器和注意力稀少的内核了解逻辑块顺序和相对位置,包括第3.2节所述的RoPE或MROPE更正.
因此,Sparse关注是AsyncLLM的补充:我们的框架提供同时执行和共享的内存视图,而QSA和DSA则可以降低超长编集观点的出席费用.
我们把这项工作的执行和经验评估留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
More generally, attention masks must be defined over the logical cache view rather than the physical layout of cached pages.
Standard causal masking is immediate, while local, modality-specific, or prefix-style masks can also be supported when visibility between a query and a cached token can be determined from metadata available at inference time, such as their logical positions, block identities, or modalities.
In these cases, composing a new cache view only changes the mask applied to the current queries.
Architectures in which changing the view would require modifying information already embedded into cached representations, rather than only changing query-to-cache visibility, may instead require recomputing the affected states and are outside the direct CacheBlock rearrangement mechanism.

标准因果掩码是即时的,而当从推断时可用的元数据,如其逻辑位置,块身份,或模式中可以确定一个查询和缓存信号之间的能见度时,也可以支持本地的,模式特有的,或前缀式的掩码.
在这些情况下,编译一个新的缓存视图只会改变当前查询所用的掩码.
改变视图需要修改已嵌入缓存表达式中的信息的架构,而不只是改变查询到缓存的能见度,而可能要求重新计算受影响的状态,不在直接缓存时钟重排机制之外。

blocks.en:
Some recurrent attention architectures, including the Gated DeltaNet layers used in Qwen 3.5+, apply a short causal depthwise convolution to the projected representations before the recurrent update ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) .
Unlike the recurrent GDN state, we do not compose or recompute these convolution states when CacheBlocks are rearranged.
Each block is computed with the convolutional context available when it is created and retains the resulting representations; if its logical predecessor later changes in a different cache_view, we do not rerun the first convolution steps at the new block boundary.
This avoids replaying tokens whenever cache views change at minimal overhead because these convolutions have a very short receptive field (e.g., 4 in Qwen 3.5).

一些经常性的注意架构,包括Quen 3.5+中使用的Gated DeltaNet层,在经常性更新之前对预测的表示进行了短暂的因果深度演化(Quen Team, 2026b ).
与反复出现的GDN状态不同的是,当CacheBlocks重排时,我们不作曲或重新计算这些演化状态.
每个区块在创建时都是根据可使用的旋动上下文计算,并保留由此产生的表达式;如果它的逻辑前身后来在不同的缓存_视图中更改,我们不会在新区块边界重运行第一个旋动步骤.
这样可以避免当缓存视图在最小的间接费用下发生变化时重放令牌,因为这些演化具有非常短的可接受字段(如Quen 3.5中的4).

Let ρ q ​ ( q , i ) \rho_{q}(q,i) and ρ k ​ ( k , j ) \rho_{k}(k,j) denote the position-dependent transformations applied to a query and key at positions i i and j j . We require that shifting a key block by an offset Δ \Delta can be equivalently expressed as an adjustment to the

blocks.en: D.5 Non-early-fusion multi-modal LLMs

blocks.en: Our current implementation targets early-fusion MLLMs in which visual embeddings participate in the decoder self-attention sequence. Late-fusion architectures based on cross-attention, such as Llama-3.2-Vision ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , require a separate visual-memory view rather than MRoPE cache rearrangement. The same CacheBlock abstraction can in principle expose these memories, but we leave this implementation to future work.

blocks.en: As we discussed earlier in Section 4.2 , our agent consists of two probes, two decoding coroutines, and non-LLM utility coroutines:
blocks.zh: 正如我们在第4.2节早些时候所讨论的那样,我们的毒剂包括两个探测器、两个解码皮层以及非LLM通用皮层:

blocks.en: 1. The event probe runs on the video stream. It receives two most recent frames and a (pre-encoded) system prompt and determines whether what happens in the two frames constitutes an event worth describing. It is pre-filled with a template and answers in a single forward pass (yes/no answer). We then compare an exponential moving average over probe probabilities ( β = 0.8 \beta{=}0.8 , not sensitive) against a threshold. 2. The background thinking thread runs constantly and that reconstructs video events from frames. It is notified whenever a probe coroutine finds an event, similar to how we notify the agent in Section 4.1 . 3. The output probe checks if the background thinking thread contains a new event based on its cache block. Like the event probe, it uses a pre-filled template and makes a decision in a single forward pass. 4. The description writer is activated whenever the output probe detects an event. It generates the output event description from the thinker’s internal state. 5. For ProactiveVideoQA TV subset, the agent also has audio inputs. We follow the original protocol for non-audio agents, using speech recognition to convert these into text. We then feed additional text inputs to the thinker in the same way we feed text clarifications in Section 4.1 . 6. We also use utility asyncio coroutines that gather the descriptions and keep track of time. These coroutines do not use the LLM.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 事件探测器在视频流上运行. 它收到两个最新的帧和一个(前编码)系统提示,并确定两个帧中发生的事情是否构成值得描述的事件. 它预先填充了模板和答案,以单张前传(是/否回答). 然后,我们将探测概率(β = 0.8\β{=}0.8,不敏感)与阈值相比的指数移动平均值进行比较。 2. 背景思维线条不断运行,从框架重建视频事件。 探测器皮层发现事件时通知它, 类似于我们如何在第4.1节通知毒剂。 3. 输出探测器检查背景思维线索是否包含基于其缓存块的新事件. 与事件探测器一样,它使用一个预填模板,并在一次前传中做出决定. 4. 当输出探测器发现某一事件时,即启动描述写入器。 它从思想家的内部状态产生输出事件描述. 5. 主动视频QA 电视子集,代理也拥有音频输入. 我们遵循非音频代理的原始协议,使用语音识别来把这些转换成文本. 然后,我们以同样的方式向思想家补充文字投入,我们在第4.1节中提供了文字澄清。 6. 我们还使用用于收集描述和跟踪时间的合成皮层。 这些皮层不使用LLM.

blocks.en: The AsyncLLM event probe uses the following prompt to detect noteworthy changes between two video frames. In contrast, Mage-VL uses a trained visual gate without a textual prompt.

blocks.en: AsyncLLM ProactiveVideoQA thinker’s system You are watching a video in real time in order to answer one question for a viewer who cannot see it. Question: {question} Each time you are shown two frames from the same camera: the first one is from a moment ago, the second one is now. You are keeping a running note of what HAPPENS, not of what is in the room. Write a line only when something CHANGED between the two frames and that change bears on the question: someone starts or finishes an action, an object moves, appears or is put down, text appears on screen. A thing that was already there and is still there is not a change and must not be written again. Otherwise write exactly this line and nothing else: - nothing new Never write a line that repeats, restates or rephrases a line already in your note. If you find yourself about to write something you have already written, write "- nothing new" instead. Repeating a line makes the note useless: it is the record of what changed, and a change written twice reads as two events. One short line per observation, each starting with "- ". Plain text only. No headings, no numbering, no bold, no JSON, no code blocks. Do not address anyone and do not comment on your own writing.
blocks.zh: AsyncLLM 主动视频QA 思想家制度 你们正在实时观看一个视频,以便回答一个无法观看的观众的问题。 问题 : {问题} 每一次从同一个相机中显示两个帧:第一个是刚才,第二个是现在. 你一直记着发生了什么 而不是房间里的东西 仅在两个框架之间发生改变, 且变化对问题有影响时, 才写一条线: 有人开始或完成动作, 对象移动, 出现或被放下, 文字出现在屏幕上 。 已经存在而且仍然存在的东西没有变化,决不能再写了。 否则就写成这行,别无其他: 永远不要写重复、重述或重写您笔记中的行。 如果你发现自己要写一些你已经写过的东西, 写"-无新意"代替。 重复一行使得音符变得无用:它是变化的记载,写作的修改两次读作两个事件. 每次观察都用短线一行,每行以 " - " 开头,只用简单的文字。 没有标题,没有编号,没有粗体,没有JSON,没有代码块. 不要对任何人说话,不要对自己的写作发表评论。

blocks.en: ProactiveVideoQA judge system prompt You are an evaluator for a video question answering system. Your task is to rate the whether the predicted answer covers the key points of the ground truth answer. Use the following scale to assign a score: - 3: Mostly covered; the predicted answer covers all key information in the ground truth answer, though it may have minor inaccuracies or rephrases. - 2: Partially covered; the predicted answer has some correct information, but also contains significant inaccuracies or missing key points. - 1: Incorrect; the predicted answer may be related to the ground truth answer, but most of the information is missing, or the predicted answer is not relevant to the question or in very poor quality.Output the score only, do not add more explanations.

blocks.en:
The fact that LLM inference can now be defined by the AsyncLLM framework directly in Python lets us hand an agent its own runtime and have it define its own inference structure. We design a minimal harness
around Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B that exposes mutable files containing its inference editable by the agent itself, at runtime, through tool calls. Each round, the agent’s mutable generate() method may produce text containing tool calls that write a new inference and then patch it onto the already-running instance in place. Additionally, the agent has an asynchronous mutable method act() which is called every environment step. The cache blocks, background tasks, and any other states the agent has allocated survive every rewrite and can be used by both methods.
blocks.zh:
LLM推论现在可以直接在Python中由AsyncLLM框架定义的事实让我们交出一个代理自己的运行时间,并让它定义自己的推论结构. 我们设计一个最小的吊带
在运行时,通过工具调用,将显示可变文件的Quen/Quen3.6-35B-A3B左右,其中包含其推论可由代理商自己编辑。 每回合,代理的可变生成( ) 方法可能会生成包含工具调用符的文本, 这些工具调用符会写出新的推论, 然后将其补上已经运行的实例 。 此外,该剂有一个同步的可变方法行为(),它被称为每一个环境步骤。 缓存块,背景任务,以及代理人分配的任何其他状态在每次重写后都能幸存下来,可以被两种方法使用.

blocks.en:
Around this loop sits an external harness: a process that repeatedly asks the agent to generate a round, applies whatever tool calls it made, scores its live environment solver against a plugged-in task environment, and reports the result back in the next round’s prompt.
For experimental setup described in Section 4.3 the same harness is instantiated across two ViZDoom ( Kempka et al., 2016 ) task environments, Health Gathering and Deadly Corridor.
The agent receives access to its runtime, the previous evaluation result, and the ability to modify its inference code, but no task-specific guidance on what inference structure to construct.
blocks.zh:
环绕这个环绕着一个外部的牵引:一个过程反复要求代理生成一个回合,应用它所说的任何工具,根据插入的任务环境对它的活环境解析器进行评分,并在下一轮的提示中报告结果。
就第4.3节所述实验性设置而言,同一吊带在两个ViZDoom(Kempka等人,2016年)任务环境、健康集会和致命走廊上被即时利用。
代理获得访问其运行时间,之前的评估结果,以及修改其推论代码的能力,但没有针对特定任务构建何种推论结构的指导.
